headline.caveat: reported as 'over $3B' — the second-largest subscription of the ~$27B A+ note issuance after PIMCO's ~$18B

nature_md: BlackRock-managed funds subscribed over $3B of the ~$27B A+ rated notes financing the Hyperion campus (Richland Parish, LA), making BlackRock the second-largest bondholder behind PIMCO. Notably, BlackRock later became the 80% equity sponsor of Meta's *next* SPV structure (El Paso, Jul 2026) — the same asset manager sits on both the debt and equity sides of Meta's off-balance-sheet build-out.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Held across BlackRock-managed fixed-income funds/accounts as investments; client money, not BlackRock Inc. balance-sheet exposure.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Debt of the JV/SPV, serviced by Meta lease payments; off Meta's balance sheet.
